linkedin.title: Pagelyt in 40 seconds
linkedin.caption:
Most website audit tools hand you 200 warnings and leave you to work out what matters.

We built Pagelyt to do the opposite. Paste a URL and in under a minute you get:

→ One clear score across 8 areas: SEO, speed, AI search, security, accessibility and more
→ Every issue ranked by impact, so you know what to fix first
→ The fix in plain English, often with code pre-filled for your site
→ Your Google Search Console, Analytics and Ads data next to each fix
→ Ask Pagelyt, an AI assistant that knows your whole report

If you audit client sites, it turns an afternoon of checks into a shareable report.

Free audit link in the first comment 👇
